SELECT dbi.id AS deviceId, dbi.device_code AS deviceCode, dbi.device_type_name AS deviceTypeName, dbi.device_sub_type_name AS deviceSubTypeName, dbi.workshop_id AS workshopId, dbi.workshop_name AS workshopName, dms.shift_date::text AS shiftDate, dms.shift_code AS shiftCode, #{metricCode} AS metricCode, -- 从JSONB中提取指标值，转换为BigDecimal (dms.metrics->>#{metricCode})::decimal AS metricValue, dms.is_finalized AS isFinalized FROM biz_device_mgmt.device_metrics_shift dms INNER JOIN biz_device_base.device_base_info dbi ON dms.device_id = dbi.id WHERE dms.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dbi.factory_id = #{factoryId} AND dms.shift_date = #{shiftDate}::date AND dms.shift_code = #{shiftCode} AND dms.metrics ? #{metricCode} -- 检查JSONB中是否存在该指标
AND dbi.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
ORDER BY
(dms.metrics->>#{metricCode})::decimal
ASC DESC
dbi.device_code
ASC DESC
(dms.metrics->>#{metricCode})::decimal DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
